Make Summary Tables per Group

Source: R/MakeSummaryTables.R
MakeSummaryTables.Rd

Performs cleaning, filtering, and summarization of a sound manifest, writes a cleaned manifest to Excel, and generates per-group summary tables as PNG images and a combined PDF.

Usage

MakeSummaryTables(manifest_file, manifest_xlsx, output_dir)

Arguments

manifest_file

A data frame produced by CreateManifest() or a path to a CSV file containing the manifest.

manifest_xlsx

Path to an Excel file where the cleaned manifest will be written.

output_dir

Directory where PNGs and the combined PDF are written.

title_base

Character string used as the base title for summary plots.

Value

Invisibly returns a list with components:

  • df1 After filtering long recordings

  • df2 After deviation filtering

  • df3 Final cleaned dataset

  • summary_table Wide summary table

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
MakeSummaryTables(
  manifest_file = sound_manifest,
  manifest_xlsx = "cleaned_manifest.xlsx",
  output_dir = "output/",
  title_base = "BBoP Deployment Summary"
)
} # }
